entry.summary: Up to 90 days in 6 months without a tourist visa.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Euro. You must declare cash and valuables valued over 10,000 euros or equivalent on arrival. This includes laptop computers, cameras and jewellery. You need to show your declaration form when you leave. If you don't, your valuables and funds could be confiscated. ATMs accept cards with Plus, Cirrus or Maestro access and are widely available.

consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy in Montenegro. You can get consular assistance from the Australian Embassy in Belgrade.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include long prison sentences in local jails.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: In some cases, it's illegal to photograph military and police: personnel establishments vehicles equipment There may be signs indicating that photography is prohibited. If you're not sure, don't take photos. Same-sex relationships are legal but not widely accepted. Avoid public displays of affection.
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: To drive, you'll need both: a valid Australian driver's license (digital driver’s licences may not be accepted) an International Driving Permit (IDP)
laws.heading: Driving permit
